title: 多轨道重叠默认是设计意图
given: showreel-24s 有多个 component 轨道在同一时间段叠加。
then: 报告声明 overlap_policy=allowed-by-default，且不输出 layout.overlap warning。

ai_tools.command: NEXTFRAME_HOME=examples target/debug/nf verify --project v2-showcase --composition showreel-24s --out ../NextFrame.archive/v0.20.0-verify/showreel-verify.json | jq '{overlap_policy: .intent.overlap_policy, overlap_checks: [.checks[] | select(.id=="layout.overlap")]}'
